scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:ml
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @civiclens/frontend && npm run typecheck -w @civiclens/backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @civiclens/frontend && npm run lint -w @civiclens/backend
scripts.build: npm run build -w @civiclens/frontend && npm run build -w @civiclens/backend
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && python -m compileall -q services/ml/app services/ml/tests
